A1.justification: Both 21-page PDFs describe the same MatchFixAgent study. Text, algorithms, figures, tables, and references support reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original validation experiments on 2,219 translation pairs, repair results, manual disagreement analysis, and agent ablations.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original validation, repair, disagreement-analysis, and ablation results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–3 retain the same six semantic analyses, test-generation and repair agent, verdict agent, and similarity thresholds.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 2,219 translation pairs from 24 projects across six language pairs. Table 1's revised coverage percentages do not establish different datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: The Oxidizer, AlphaTrans, Skel, and RustRepoTrans comparisons and standalone-agent ablations are retained. The two newly cited works in Section 5 are not evaluated as comparators.

E3.justification: Sampling, model and agent configurations, timeout, manual-review procedures, and patch-validation criteria remain unchanged. The revised Table 1 percentages do not document changed tests or evaluation settings.

E4.justification: Sections 4.2 and 4.5 retain the same disagreement categories, illustrative failure cases, and ablations removing semantic analysis and test generation. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions state in Section 6 that experiments were run once. Neither adds repeated runs, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 revises test-coverage values for four AlphaTrans and seven Skel projects: for example, fileupload changes from 100% to 20.8%, cli from 100% to 93.8%, and colorsys from 96.3% to 100%. These revisions reconcile the values with Table 3's retained coverage gains. Validation, repair, and ablation results otherwise remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The equivalence definitions and graph/path similarity computations are retained. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about language-agnostic validation and repair, low implementation overhead, and the benefits of the multi-agent architecture.

C2.justification: Interpretations of validation disagreements, project complexity, and semantic guidance remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same limitations concerning nondeterminism, incomplete ground-truth assessment, and generalizability.

D1.justification: The Tree-Sitter implementation, runtime versions, logging, timeout, and implementation-size disclosures are unchanged. No implementation instructions or code/data access information are added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 5 adds citations to Dehghan et al., Translating Large-Scale C Repositories to Idiomatic Rust, and Ke et al., Advancing Automated In-Isolation Validation in Repository-Level Code Translation. Both join the existing test-execution category; the broader positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: Footnote 3 changes rule-based transpilers' description from not proposing to not including a validation mechanism. There are also minor unit-formatting, bibliographic, and version-stamp edits; the section order and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The added references cause limited bibliography reflow across pages 19–21, with small line-wrap changes elsewhere. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–3 retain their designs and placement; Table 1's numerical revisions are assessed under E6.

improvement.justification: The revised Table 1 resolves inconsistencies with the unchanged coverage improvements in Table 3. For example, fileupload's revised 20.8% baseline correctly reconciles with 98.9% coverage after a 78.1-point gain. This improves internal consistency, while two additional citations modestly update related-work coverage. The method, main evidence, and limitations remain unchanged.
